leaves.name: faltingsLemma1DVRPrint
leaves.doc: Faltings 1983, p. 350, Lemma 1 (page read by the reading desk): a generic-fibre homomorphism of semiabelian schemes with abelian generic fibres extends uniquely as a morphism. S = Spec O is normal and U is its dense generic open. The model hypotheses give extensions by actual torus group schemes on both residue-field fibres, by isSemiabelianModelO_imp_faltingsDefScheme. The specialization is faltingsLemma1DVRPrint_of_printed; faltingsLemma1DVR_iff_print proves equivalence to the homomorphism form.
